app.name: Zankup
app.claim: Your sports data, from start to finish.

feed.title: Activities
feed.empty: No activities yet. They appear here after the first Garmin sync.
activity.notFound: This activity does not exist or is not yours.
notFound.title: Page not found
signIn.panel: Your private Zankup instance. Sync with Garmin, import your Strava history and follow your form without depending on anyone.
signIn.codeSub: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
signIn.error.noTotp: Two-step verification is not set up for this account yet. Set it up with python -m zankup.admin enable-totp.
signIn.error.tooMany: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} s.
signIn.error.expired: That took too long. Enter your password again.
signIn.error.passkey: That passkey could not be used.
signIn.error.network: The server could not be reached. Check your connection.
setup.title: Create your account
setup.sub: This instance has no account yet. It will be yours alone.
setup.codeHelp: It is in the server logs (Railway → Deployments → Logs): "Sign-up is open… setup code: XXXX-XXXX-XXXX".
setup.name: Your name
setup.passwordHelp: At least 12 characters. Checked against known data breaches without sending it.
setup.accept: I understand that my data stays on this instance, which only I run, and that Zankup has no central service.
setup.totpSub: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Aegis…), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
setup.totpKey: Can't scan it? Enter this key
setup.recoverySub: If you lose your phone, each of these codes replaces the 6-digit code once. Keep them somewhere safe: they will not be shown again.
setup.saved: I have saved my recovery codes
setup.doneSub: Your account is ready and you are signed in.
setup.next.garmin: Activities from Garmin arrive every 15 minutes; your full history can be loaded too.
setup.next.strava: Strava history and themes come next.
setup.closedSub: This instance already has its account.
setup.error.code: That setup code is not right. Copy it again from the server logs.
setup.error.name: Enter your name.
setup.error.accept: Accept how your data is handled to continue.
setup.error.short: The password must have at least 12 characters.
setup.error.expired: That took too long. Start again with the setup code.
feed.pick: Pick an activity to see its details.
